project_type: Full-stack React SPA (Vite) + FastAPI backend + Cloudflare Edge Worker
build_system: Vite for frontend build, npm scripts. Backend uses FastAPI with uvicorn.
test_framework: vitest for frontend unit tests, pytest for backend
verification_instructions: 1. Run frontend build (vite build). 2. Run vitest for frontend. 3. Check that cookie consent component renders. 4. Validate _redirects file syntax. 5. Validate seo.py has lastmod in SITEMAP_STATIC_XML.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Node.js 22 available via nvm. Python 3.11 available via pyenv.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing Tailwind CSS patterns, use lazy loading for new components, follow existing localStorage key naming convention (syrabit_ prefix)
key_patterns: Components use functional React with hooks. Lazy-loaded via React.lazy(). PWAInstallPrompt is the closest pattern match for a banner component (fixed position, localStorage dismiss, animation). Analytics uses window.posthog directly. _redirects uses Cloudflare Pages syntax. Backend uses FastAPI APIRouter with Response objects for XML output.
directory_structure: apps/frontend/src/components/ - shared components. apps/frontend/src/pages/ - page components. apps/frontend/public/ - static assets and CF Pages config. apps/backend/app/api/v1/ - backend API routes. apps/edge/src/ - Cloudflare Edge Worker.
